The client-intake `clients` and neighborhood-hub `tool_reservations` ties at 10 are mutually exclusive by condition, so harmless (lead analysis).

remedy: add a deterministic tie-breaker (`column_name` for properties, `id` for actions) to the `schema_properties` / `schema_entity_actions` views, or to the consumers' sorts (the core).

rows.mcp: Same `in.()` / `in.not-an-array` / unquoted items for the inputs it accepts (`and=(...)` in the per-entity cases, Q-09); rejects null items at input validation.
rows.reason: Both sides share the quoting gap (a value with a comma is split). Suggested core rule: drop empty in-lists, quote items, keep `eq.false` / `eq.0` (valid).
rows.rule: The in filter emits `in.()`, `in.not-an-array` and empty items (`1,,`); `eq.false` and `eq.0` are emitted; in-list items are never quoted
